title: Chapter 2 MC and Extension parallel-question generation
rules: Keep 3 MC and 3 Extension families per CPM lesson column.
Use section learning goals and supporting skills to govern each family, not arbitrary prompts.
Keep original question as version 1; number-swap meaningful parameters for versions 2-7.
MC: four unique answers, one provably correct, rotate placement; worked solution per version.
Use actual unit tile figures, not text-only descriptions, for visual tile tasks.
MC and Extensions use a single flat set; no difficulty levels.
Provide New Question for each family, cycle through 7 versions.
Perform math, render, duplicate, wrong-answer and original preservation checks before teacher review.
Block generation to student assessments until teacher approval.
